title: Match Maker
description:
A mod that improves multiplayer convenience and adds automatic matchmaking.
Match multiplayer lobbies based on community name / language / ascension / player count / installed mods, or use quick rehosting and kick/ban features.

Doesn't affect gameplay, so you can freely play with people who don't have it installed.

https://github.com/TalkingHand/sts2-matchmaker
changeNote: Matching settings (community/language/game mode/player count/host-allowed) are now saved the instant you change them, instead of only when a button is pressed - a search you cancelled and left through some other path no longer reverts to old values on reopen, and settings now reliably carry over from guest search to host when auto-match switches you to hosting.
